entries.title: A compatible Solana wallet is required.
entries.safe_message: The browser could not access a compatible Solana wallet.
entries.guidance: Install or unlock the wallet, then start this step again.

entries.title: The wallet request was cancelled.
entries.safe_message: The wallet did not approve this request.
entries.guidance: Nothing was submitted. Review the step and approve it when ready.

entries.title: The network service could not be reached.
entries.safe_message: The request could not reach its service.
entries.guidance: Check the connection and retry the step when the service is reachable.

entries.title: The request timed out.
entries.safe_message: The request outcome could not be established before the timeout.
entries.guidance: Do not assume failure. Inspect available state before another attempt.

entries.title: The service is receiving too many requests.
entries.safe_message: The request was rate limited before completion.
entries.guidance: Wait briefly, then start a fresh attempt.

entries.title: The Solana RPC request was rejected.
entries.safe_message: The RPC node rejected the request before transaction processing.
entries.guidance: Review the request and RPC response before trying again.

entries.title: The Devnet transaction expired before Solana accepted it.
entries.safe_message: Solana rejected this transaction before submission because its blockhash expired.
entries.guidance: No chain effect was observed. Start this step again to build and sign a fresh transaction.

entries.title: The Devnet transaction expired before submission.
entries.safe_message: The transaction blockhash expired before the wallet submission began.
entries.guidance: Nothing was submitted. Start this step again to build and sign a fresh transaction.

entries.title: A Solana instruction was rejected.
entries.safe_message: Transaction simulation rejected one instruction.
entries.guidance: Inspect the instruction error and correct its inputs before another attempt.

entries.title: The transaction finalized with a protocol error.
entries.safe_message: Solana finalized the transaction with an error.
entries.guidance: Inspect the transaction evidence before preparing another attempt.

entries.title: The hosted service rejected this step.
entries.safe_message: The hosted service could not complete the requested operation.
entries.guidance: Review the service error and current protocol state before retrying.

entries.title: This identity has a different binding.
entries.safe_message: The identity already exists with a different wallet or encryption key.
entries.guidance: Do not overwrite it. Resume the exact matching session or choose a new Knowledge Identity.

entries.title: This operation identifier was already consumed.
entries.safe_message: The hosted service found an earlier operation with this identifier.
entries.guidance: Inspect the saved operation and its effect. Do not mint a successor automatically.

entries.title: The KEP instruction is invalid.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program rejected the instruction encoding.
entries.guidance: Rebuild the operation with the current protocol contract.

entries.title: A KEP account address is invalid.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program rejected a derived account address.
entries.guidance: Rebuild the operation from the exact artifact and participant identifiers.

entries.title: A required KEP signature is missing.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program did not receive every required signer.
entries.guidance: Connect the required wallet and prepare a fresh operation.

entries.title: This wallet cannot authorize the KEP operation.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program rejected the supplied authority.
entries.guidance: Verify the acting identity and owner state before another attempt.

entries.title: The artifact changed before this action completed.
entries.safe_message: The submitted revision no longer matches the artifact.
entries.guidance: Reload finalized state and prepare a new operation.

entries.title: This recipient is already an owner.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program found the recipient in the owner set.
entries.guidance: Inspect current ownership instead of submitting another grant.

entries.title: The recipient is not an active owner.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program could not find the required recipient.
entries.guidance: Reload finalized owner state before continuing.

entries.title: The reissue request no longer matches.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program rejected the reissue request binding.
entries.guidance: Load the current request and prepare a new fulfillment.

entries.title: This reissue was already fulfilled.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program found the reissue already complete.
entries.guidance: Inspect finalized access instead of submitting again.

entries.title: A KEP account has the wrong owner.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program rejected an account owner binding.
entries.guidance: Verify every account belongs to the expected program.

entries.title: KEP account data could not be encoded.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program could not serialize required state.
entries.guidance: Inspect account layout and protocol-version compatibility.

entries.title: The encryption epoch is invalid.
entries.safe_message: The KEP program rejected the encryption epoch.
entries.guidance: Reload the artifact and prepare an operation for its current epoch.

entries.title: This handoff card is not compatible.
entries.safe_message: The supplied public card does not match the required KEP schema.
entries.guidance: Use the public card exported by the matching KEP step. No protocol effect occurred.

entries.title: The connected wallet is not the registered identity.
entries.safe_message: This step requires the wallet registered for the selected KEP identity.
entries.guidance: Connect the matching wallet before starting the step again. Nothing was submitted.

entries.title: B’s access envelope cannot be authenticated.
entries.safe_message: The recipient envelope does not match B’s key and finalized artifact revision.
entries.guidance: Do not repeat the access request. Verify the key binding and envelope revision; use governed reissue if the finalized envelope is invalid.

entries.title: The encrypted artifact failed its commitment check.
entries.safe_message: The retrieved ciphertext does not match the committed artifact bytes.
entries.guidance: Do not decrypt or retry automatically. Inspect the stored artifact and commitment evidence.

entries.title: The encrypted knowledge could not be opened.
entries.safe_message: The content key could not authenticate the encrypted artifact.
entries.guidance: Do not retry automatically. Verify the artifact, content-key envelope, and encryption context; use governed reissue if the access envelope is invalid.

entries.title: The recovered knowledge failed its commitment check.
entries.safe_message: The recovered plaintext does not match the artifact commitment.
entries.guidance: Discard the plaintext and inspect the artifact, envelope, and key-binding evidence.

entries.title: This step could not be classified.
entries.safe_message: The operation failed and its protocol effect is unknown.
entries.guidance: Do not retry automatically. Inspect current state and available evidence first.
